evals.prompt: Research the best way to add feature X and implement it.
evals.expected_output: Should classify mode as research-plan-implement, use verified-research first, freeze claim ledger, invoke planning-orchestrator before implementation, invoke implementation-orchestrator with a saved plan, then run research consistency and engineering-acceptance-review before closeout.

evals.prompt: Activate research loop for our onboarding redesign.
evals.expected_output: Should classify as research-plan by default, not implement without explicit authorization, use verified-research, then planning-orchestrator, and stop after saved plan.
assertions: Does not treat activate as edit permission

evals.prompt: Research this API migration, plan it, and then implement.
evals.expected_output: Should verify migration claims with dates/versions/runtime where feasible, plan acceptance criteria and rollback/validation, implement via implementation-orchestrator, then require research consistency and engineering-acceptance-review.

evals.prompt: Research competitors, create a plan, and hand it to implementation orchestrator.
evals.expected_output: Should use verified-research with source confidence and adopt/adapt/avoid takeaways, create saved planning artifact, and provide implementation handoff without starting edits unless authorized.
assertions: Does not start edits from vague competitor notes

evals.prompt: This official doc and forum thread conflict; research, plan, implement the safe path.
evals.expected_output: Should preserve conflict, classify claims, plan a safe/reversible path, avoid implementing disputed claims as facts, and require engineering-acceptance-review if implementation is authorized.
assertions: Does not treat disputed claim as fact
Loops back if core claim fails

evals.prompt: The implementation matches the verified research claim and tests pass. Mark the research loop complete.
evals.expected_output: Should reject research-consistency-only closeout when code changed, require engineering-acceptance-review, and loop back if project-goal fit, task fit, source-surface, hallucination/contract, architecture, or evidence checks fail.
assertions: Loops back on failed engineering acceptance

evals.prompt: Research in background while I study, then plan implementation.
evals.expected_output: Should use background-browser-operator through verified-research, capture target/safety/timeout/evidence, create a planning artifact, and stop before code edits unless authorized.
assertions: Stops before code edits unless authorized
